process_area.title: SCO & Scan-&-Go Daily Operations & Customer Experience

value_stream.name: Self-Checkout, Scan-&-Go & Unattended Retail Technology Operations

fields.Participants: Store Ops (VS-07), Frontend (VS-08), Cashiers/Attendants, IFM (VS-138), IT (VS-27)

workflows.name: SCO & Scan-&-Go Lane Daily Open/Close & Staffing

Automation Opportunity: - Terminal-health/calibration auto-check on boot; cash-recycler load/reconcile workflow; attendant-ratio/peak scheduler
Controls: - CTL-678 (ensure controlled execution — SCO & Scan-&-Go Daily Operations & Customer Experience (PA-149.2).)
- CTL-678: terminal health & calibration checked at open; cash-recycler loaded/reconciled; attendant ratio met; exceptions handed off
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-115 (calibration), VS-07 (store), W4445 (cash), W4448 (peak), W4450 (exception)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Calibration-drift risk**: un-calibrated scale at open → false interventions/scan-avoidance; mitigated by open calibration check (VS-115)
- **Under-staffing risk**: attendant ratio too thin → intervention queue/friction; mitigated by ratio standard & peak staffing (W4448)
System Touchpoints: - SCO terminal (VS-08); calibration (VS-115); cash-recycler (W4445); POS-ERP (VS-08); exception (W4450); IT (VS-27)
Time Estimate: - ~40–60 min open+close/day × 200 stores; staffing built into frontend model

steps.activity: Frontend open the SCO pod — terminal boot/health check, scale/calibration check (VS-115), cash-recycler load/float (W4445), signage, and attendant station setup
Frontend staff the pod — attendant ratio (1:4–6 SCO), intervention-ready, monitoring; open/close scan-&-go & unattended formats per W4439
Frontend close the pod — cash-recycler pull/reconcile (W4445), transaction settlement, terminal close, and exception handoff (W4450)

fields.Participants: Attendants, Frontend (VS-08), Cashiers, Store Ops (VS-07), Loyalty (VS-13)
fields.Volume: SCO share grows with rollout (target 20–40% of baskets)

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time price/promo/loyalty; auto-e-invoice; intervention-queue dashboard; proactive-assist prompts
Controls: - CTL-678 (ensure controlled execution — SCO & Scan-&-Go Daily Operations & Customer Experience (PA-149.2).)
- CTL-678: tender/price/promo/loyalty correct; BIR-compliant receipt/e-invoice; inventory synced; exceptions managed
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-80 (payment), VS-13 (loyalty), VS-79 (BIR/e-invoice), W4443 (intervention), W4450 (exception)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Intervention-queue risk**: flags pile up → customer friction; mitigated by proactive assistance & ratio (W4448)
- **Receipt/e-invoice risk**: BIR non-compliant SCO receipt; mitigated by CAS-registered SCO & e-invoicing
System Touchpoints: - SCO/POS-ERP (VS-08); payment (VS-80); loyalty (VS-13); e-invoice (VS-79); inventory sync; intervention (W4443); exception (W4450)
Time Estimate: - ~per-transaction minutes (faster than staffed for small baskets)

steps.activity: Customer scans/bags/pays at SCO; attendant monitors pod, proactively assists first-timers/seniors/PWD, and intervenes on flags (W4443)
SCO processes tender (cash/card/e-wallet/loyalty), applies price/promo/loyalty real-time, issues BIR-compliant receipt/e-invoice (VS-79), and syncs inventory (VS-08)
Attendant handles exceptions (price dispute, system error, intervention), keeps the pod flowing, and escalates complex cases (W4450)

fields.Participants: Attendants, Frontend (VS-08), Compliance (VS-22), DG (VS-114), LP (VS-23), HSE (VS-24)

Automation Opportunity: - Flag-to-attendant dispatch; ID-verification capture; override-auth workflow with SoD; override-pattern analytics
Controls: - CTL-678: flags actioned per policy; override within authority matrix & logged; age verified; patterns audited (W4449/W4450)
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-114 (DG), VS-115 (calibration), VS-23 (LP), VS-21 (audit), W4438 (intervention design), W4450 (exception)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Override-abuse risk**: attendant/manager overrides used to fraud/discount; mitigated by authority matrix (SoD) & override logging (W4450)
- **Age-verification-failure risk**: minor served; mitigated by ID-check protocol & audit
System Touchpoints: - SCO item-control (VS-08/W4438); DG (VS-114); calibration (VS-115); LP/exception (VS-23/W4450); override-auth (SoD); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Attendant respond to flag — age-restricted (ID-verify per W4438), DG/hazmat (block/authorize per W4438), catch-weight (weigh/measure VS-115), weight-mismatch (re-scan/inspect), price-override (manager auth per SoD)
Attendant/Manager authorize override within authority matrix (W4453), log the override (exception W4450), and apply the price/quantity change
Compliance/LP audit intervention/override patterns for abuse (links W4449/W4450) and tune the flag set (W4438)

fields.Participants: App (VS-75), Frontend (VS-08), IT (VS-27), LP (VS-23), Loyalty (VS-13), Payment (VS-80)
fields.Volume: Scan-&-go sessions (share of ecommerce/app traffic VS-75)

workflows.name: Scan-&-Go Mobile App Session & Checkout Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - Risk-based exit-audit engine; scan-vs-paid reconciliation; in-app payment; session-abandonment analytics
Controls: - CTL-678: price/promo/tax real-time; exit-verification risk-based; receipt/e-invoice BIR-compliant; inventory synced; exceptions routed
Cross-references: - links to VS-75 (app), VS-10 (ecommerce), VS-08 (POS), VS-80 (payment), VS-23 (LP/exit), W4436 (scan-&-go design), W4450 (exception)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scan-vs-pay-mismatch risk**: customer pays for fewer items than leaves; mitigated by risk-based exit-verify (W4436/W4437)
- **Session-abandonment risk**: app friction → abandonment; mitigated by UX optimization (W4447)
System Touchpoints: - App (VS-75); POS-ERP (VS-08); payment (VS-80); loyalty (VS-13); LP/exit-verify (VS-23); e-invoice (VS-79); BI (VS-28)

steps.activity: Customer scans items via app/handheld (W4436), sees running total (price/promo/tax real-time), and pays in-app (VS-80) or at exit-kiosk
Frontend/LP run the exit-verification (risk-based audit per W4436), reconcile scanned-basket vs paid, and clear/flag for review
App/Frontend close the session, issue BIR receipt/e-invoice (VS-79), sync inventory (VS-08), and route exceptions (W4450)

fields.Participants: Frontend (VS-08), Cash Office, CIT (VS-81), Treasury (VS-18), LP (VS-23), IFM (VS-138)
fields.Trigger: SCO cash tender; daily open/close; cash-recycler cycle
fields.Volume: SCO cash across 200 stores (cash share ~42% of transactions)

workflows.name: SCO Cash Management, Cash-Recycler & Tender Handling

Automation Opportunity: - Cash-recycler reconciliation; smart-safe/CIT integration (VS-81); variance auto-alert; recycler-fault monitoring
Controls: - CTL-678 (ensure controlled execution — SCO & Scan-&-Go Daily Operations & Customer Experience (PA-149.2).)
- CTL-678: cash-recycler float/reconcile daily; reconciled to system tenders; variances investigated (W4452); CIT/sweep managed
Cross-references: - links to VS-08.2 (cash office), VS-81 (CIT), VS-18 (treasury), VS-23 (LP), VS-138 (IFM), W4441 (open/close), W4452 (variance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cash-variance risk**: SCO cash mismatch → leakage; mitigated by daily reconciliation & variance investigation (W4452)
- **Recycler-fault risk**: fault stops cash tender; mitigated by uptime management (W4446) & IFM servicing
System Touchpoints: - Cash-recycler; cash office (VS-08.2); CIT/smart-safe (VS-81); treasury (VS-18); POS-ERP (VS-08); LP (VS-23); IFM (VS-138)

steps.activity: Frontend/Cash Office manage the SCO cash-recycler — load float at open, accept cash tenders, dispense change, and pull/reconcile at close (W4441)
Cash Office reconcile SCO cash to system tenders daily, investigate variances (W4452), and manage cash-recycler faults (W4446)
CIT/Treasury manage SCO cash pickup (smart-safe, armored VS-81), sweep to bank (VS-18), and the cash-recycler maintenance/servicing (IFM)

fields.Participants: IT Service Desk (VS-27.1), Frontend (VS-08), IFM (VS-138), Vendor (VS-34), Store Ops (VS-07)

workflows.name: SCO Hardware/Software Incident, Fault & Uptime Management

Automation Opportunity: - Remote diagnostics/auto-reset; fault-to-vendor routing; uptime/MTTR/MTBF dashboard; spares/servicing auto-trigger
Controls: - CTL-678 (ensure controlled execution — SCO & Scan-&-Go Daily Operations & Customer Experience (PA-149.2).)
- CTL-678: fault logged & unit out-of-service; SLA resolution with health/calibration check; uptime tracked; recurring faults fed to design
Cross-references: - links to VS-27.1 (service desk), VS-08 (POS), VS-115 (calibration), VS-138 (IFM), VS-34 (vendor), W4441 (open/close), W4455 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Downtime risk**: SCO out of service → queue/capex-idle; mitigated by uptime SLA & spares
- **Recurring-fault risk**: same fault repeated → poor availability; mitigated by MTBF tracking & vendor/design feedback
System Touchpoints: - IT service desk (VS-27.1); SCO/POS-ERP (VS-08); calibration (VS-115); IFM CMMS (VS-138); vendor (VS-34); BI (VS-28)

steps.activity: Frontend/Store log the fault (terminal/scale/recycler/camera/software) via service desk (VS-27.1), take the unit out of service, and re-route customers
IT/Vendor/IFM triage & resolve — software reset/patch, hardware swap, calibration (VS-115), recycler service — within SLA (uptime target)
IT/Frontend restore to service with health/calibration check, track uptime/MTTR/MTBF (W4455), and feed recurring faults to vendor/design (W4434)

fields.Participants: CX (VS-13), Frontend (VS-08), Visual Merch (VS-55), Store Ops (VS-07), Enablement (VS-124), App (VS-75)
fields.Trigger: SCO operation; adoption review; CX feedback

workflows.name: Customer SCO Education, Signage & Friction Reduction

Automation Opportunity: - Adoption/funnel analytics; friction-point detection; UX A/B testing; VOC integration
Controls: - CTL-678 (ensure controlled execution — SCO & Scan-&-Go Daily Operations & Customer Experience (PA-149.2).)
- CTL-678: education/signage multilingual & PWD-friendly; first-timer assistance; friction iterated on data; adoption measured (W4455)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-55 (visual merch), VS-75 (app), VS-124 (enablement), VS-146 (service quality), W4454 (accessibility), W4455 (adoption)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Friction risk**: confusing SCO → abandonment/complaints; mitigated by UX iteration & assistance
- **Exclusion risk**: seniors/PWD can't use SCO; mitigated by assistance & accessibility (W4454)
System Touchpoints: - CX (VS-13); visual merch/signage (VS-55); app (VS-75); enablement (VS-124); VOC/service-quality (VS-13/VS-146); BI (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - Continuous (folded into frontend/CX); periodic design iteration

steps.activity: CX/Visual Merch design SCO education & signage — on-screen prompts, floor signage, how-to, first-timer assistance, multilingual (Filipino/English), PWD-friendly (W4454)
Frontend/Attendants proactively assist first-timers/seniors/PWD, capture friction feedback, and feed into design (W4434/W4435) and CX (VS-13)
CX/App iterate UX (scan-&-go app, SCO screen) on adoption/funnel data (W4455), VOC (VS-13), and service-quality (VS-146) findings

fields.Participants: Frontend (VS-08), Store Ops (VS-07), WFM (VS-19.3), LP (VS-23), Customer Safety (VS-147)

Automation Opportunity: - Footfall/queue predictive staffing; dynamic SCO open-ratio; wait-time analytics; line-busting dispatch
Controls: - CTL-678 (ensure controlled execution — SCO & Scan-&-Go Daily Operations & Customer Experience (PA-149.2).)
- CTL-678: peak forecast & staffing; dynamic open-ratio; intervention queue managed; crowd-safety coordinated (VS-147); post-peak review
Cross-references: - links to VS-19.3 (WFM), VS-08 (POS), VS-28 (footfall/queue), VS-147/W4399 (safety/crowd), W4435 (layout), W4455 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Queue/friction risk**: insufficient open SCO → queue → abandonment; mitigated by peak forecasting & dynamic open-ratio
- **Crowd-safety risk**: queue into aisles → safety (VS-147/W4399); mitigated by queue management & safety coordination
System Touchpoints: - WFM/scheduling (VS-19.3); POS (VS-08); footfall/queue analytics (VS-28); customer safety (VS-147); BI (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - Peak hours; staffing built into WFM

steps.activity: Frontend/WFM forecast peak demand, set SCO-pod open ratio & attendant staffing, and align to crowd/crowd-safety (VS-147/W4399)
Frontend manage queue in real-time — open/close SCO, allocate attendant, mobile/line-busting if available, manage intervention queue, and balance vs staffed POS
Frontend/WFM review wait-time/throughput post-peak (W4455), tune staffing/open-ratio, and feed learning to layout (W4435)/WFM (VS-19.3)
